title: India Launches PRISM-SG Portal To Slash Road Over Bridge Approval Times From Nearly One Year To Just 3-4 Months
text:
Infrastructure
Swarajya Staff
Mar 26, 2026 | Updated 09:30 AM GMT+5:30
Save & read from anywhere!

India has launched the PRISM-SG (Portal for Rail-Road Inspection & Stages Management – Steel Girders) Portal yesterday (25 March) in New Delhi, marking a significant shift towards digital infrastructure management. Minister for Road Transport and Highways, Nitin Gadkari, alongside Minister for Railways, Information & Broadcasting, Electronics & IT, Ashwini Vaishnaw, launched the portal to improve efficiency, transparency and inter-agency coordination in infrastructure development.
The portal addresses longstanding inefficiencies in Road Over Bridge construction approvals.
Currently, the construction of ROBs requires multiple approvals from Indian Railways, including the General Arrangement Drawing, Structural Drawings, Quality Assurance Plan, Welding Procedure Specification Sheet and fabrication stage inspections of steel girders.
While GAD and Structural Drawings approvals are processed through the RRCAS portal, the other processes related to QAP, WPSS and fabrication inspections are mainly conducted offline or through physical means.
This often results in delays, along with limited real-time tracking and coordination amongst stakeholders.
The digital platform integrates all key stakeholders, including Road Owning Departments, Indian Railways, contractors, fabricators and inspection agencies.
The portal allows for end-to-end online submission of documents, scrutiny, raising and resolving queries, approvals, scheduling inspections and uploading inspection reports, photographs and test results.
The initiative aims to deliver substantial time savings in project execution.
The portal aims to reduce the approval and inspection timeline from approximately 12 months to about three to four months, thereby enhancing project efficiency, transparency and accountability.
The system incorporates features such as the Quality Assurance Plan, Welding Procedure Specification Sheet and fabrication stage inspections of steel girders.
The launch strengthens India's infrastructure delivery mechanisms. The portal will play a crucial role in ensuring the timely completion of ROBs and Railway Bridges, thereby strengthening infrastructure delivery and enhancing connectivity across the country.
